The Blue Kite: 两个男孩分享一只风筝。
Paul has a beautiful blue kite. His friend Dan wants to fly it, but Paul says no. It is his favourite toy.
On Sunday, Paul flies the kite in the park alone. Suddenly, the string breaks and the kite flies away. Paul cries.
The next day, Dan comes to Paul with the kite. He finds it in a tree near his home. Paul is surprised. Now the two boys fly the kite together every weekend, and they take turns to hold the string.
